items.actClause: AN ACT to grant Cole Samsel eligibility for permanent appointment as a police officer with the police department of the village of Oxford, in the county of Chenango
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S1159

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to grant Cole Samsel eligibility for permanent
appointment as a police officer with the police department of the
village of Oxford, in the county of Chenango

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

Grants eligibility to Cole Samsel for permanent appointment as a
police officer with the village of Oxford police department even
though he is over the age of 35.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Notwithstanding any provision of paragraph (a) of
subdivision 1 or subdivision 4 of section 58 of the civil service law
to the contrary, Cole Samsel, who previously received a permanent
appointment in the competitive class of civil service as a police
officer with the sheriff s department of the county of Chenango,
resigned from such position after several years, has been absent from
such position for more than 30 days and is over the age of 35, shall
be eligible for provisional or permanent appointment in the
competitive class of the civil service as a police officer of the
police department of the village of Oxford, in the county of Chenango,
if he shall, at the time if his appointment, be 40 years of age or
younger.

JUSTIFICATION:

Under the Civil Service Law, as proscribed under Section 58, no
individual may take the Civil Service examination nor be eligible for
a Civil Service eligibility limit of the age of 35 or older. Due to
this limitation, the Village of Oxford Police Department has requested
legislation to permit one of their part-time officers, Cole Samsel to
be eligible to take the Civil Service examination since he is
currently 35 years old. In small rural areas, it is difficult to
attract or maintain qualified applicants to fill such positions. The
resurgence of heroin and increase in criminal activity is on the rise,
filling this full-time officer position would enable the police
department to reduce crime and better protect the community. Upon Cole
Samel passing the examination, should qualify him to fill the vacant
full-time position within the Village of Oxford Police Department.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

EFFECTIVE DATE:

This act shall take effect immediately.
